Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ehds-data-category-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
ehr Electronic Health RecordsElectronic health data originating from electronic health records.
health-factors Health Determinant DataData concerning factors that influence health, including socioeconomic, environmental, and behavioural determinants.
healthcare-resources Healthcare Needs, Resources and Financing DataAggregated data concerning healthcare needs, allocated resources, access to healthcare, healthcare expenditure, and financing.
pathogen-data Pathogen DataData concerning pathogens that affect human health.
admin-claims Administrative and Claims DataHealth-related administrative data, including claims and reimbursement information.
human-genomic Human Genetic, Epigenomic and Genomic DataHuman genetic, epigenomic, and genomic data.
molecular-omics Human Molecular DataHuman molecular data, including proteomic, transcriptomic, metabolomic, lipidomic, and comparable omics data.
device-generated-personal Person-Generated Device DataPersonal electronic health data generated automatically through medical devices.
wellness-apps Wellness Application DataElectronic health-related data generated through wellness applications.
professional-status Healthcare Professional DataData concerning the professional status, specialization, and institution of healthcare professionals involved in treatment.
public-health-registry Population-Based Health Registry DataData from population-based health registries.
medical-mortality-registry Medical and Mortality Registry DataData from medical registries and mortality registries.
clinical-trial Clinical Study and Investigation DataData from clinical trials, clinical studies, clinical investigations, and performance studies.
medical-device-other Other Medical Device DataOther electronic health data generated through medical devices that are not represented by a more specific category.
medicinal-device-registry Medicinal Product and Medical Device Registry DataData from registries for medicinal products and medical devices.
research-cohort-survey Research Cohort, Questionnaire and Survey DataData from research cohorts, questionnaires, and health-related surveys.
biobank Biobank DataElectronic health data from biobanks and associated databases.
